## VantaVault v0.5.28

### Added
- A phone-oriented Android companion surface built on the same supported remote-account contracts as desktop.
- Stored player-card previews and clearer session diagnostics in Account Manager.
- Cached per-agent match evidence for the live-match view, sourced from already stored completed matches.

### Improved
- Account Manager preserves the saved account order while open, reveals the current account directly, and applies favorite sorting only after reopening.
- Live match, party, presets, sprays, profile, storefront, activity, and chat views handle incomplete Riot fields more safely.
- Rank progression and match analytics clearly distinguish cached history from live data.

### Fixed
- Refreshing no longer replaces a deliberately selected remote account with a different local Riot Client account.
- Selecting an account no longer moves it to the top of Account Manager.
- Live party context and agent records reuse durable local cache data instead of creating live history request bursts.
- Desktop startup and recovery errors stay contained within the app instead of showing a framework error page.

### Download
- **Windows Portable:** `VantaVault-portable.exe` — run directly with no setup.
- **Windows Installer:** `VantaVault_0.5.28_x64-setup.exe` — optional per-user installation.

### Auto-update
Both Windows release types update from inside VantaVault. Android debug and signed builds are produced through the repository workflows and are not published on Google Play.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/akawazak/valo-project/compare/v0.5.27...v0.5.28
